_about: The tunable rules of the game. Merton, as game designer, may propose changes to this file by pull request, inside the bounds in `bounds`. Nothing here is constitutional: the constitution is league/constitution.py.

audit._about: The promotion audit. house_pays (Sept 23, 2026): the House pays for the audit of an agent that cleared the screen, so a paper agent's purse no longer decides whether real money looks at it (hawkins waited at 'cannot cover its audit' on Sept 22). min_credits_usd applies only when house_pays is false.

research._about_evidence_max_turns: Sept 23, 2026 (the north-star build, D6): an agent with evidence -- on paper or above with at least one closed trade -- may run its research session to evidence_max_turns instead of max_turns (league/lab.py has_evidence).

pace._about: Winners run, losers wait (owner's direction, Sept 21, 2026). A profitable earned record researches at winner_share of the interval, and replay-passing candidates are born its children; an agent on paper or above with loser_min_observations of evidence and a losing record waits loser_multiple times as long.
pace._about_sept23: Sept 23, 2026: 84% of research sessions since 21:10Z Sept 22 ended by abstaining, most of them by agents with no record. With the burst's base interval at 15 minutes (turbo research_minutes), an agent with no earned record researches every 45 minutes (unproven_multiple), a winner every 1.5 minutes (winner_share), a loser every 2 hours (loser_multiple); the money moves to the foundry.
pace._about_sept23_pacing: Sept 23, 2026, 16:41 UTC (C3 pacing): an agent with no earned record researches every 6 intervals (90 minutes at the 15-minute burst interval; was 45 minutes): 82-84% of such sessions abstained on Sept 22, and the paced OpenAI line goes first to agents with a record and to audits.

gate._about: Sept 22, 2026 overnight v0: after `after` empty passes in a row (no candidate, no replay, no Merton strategy) and nothing new on the agent's record, the interval doubles per further empty pass up to max_factor; sample_percent of skipped windows still run so misses stay measurable.
gate._about_sept23_evidence: Sept 23, 2026 (the learn-and-unblock run, S3/C3; league/research_gate.py rules 6 and 7). Measured 00:00Z Sept 22 to 16:28Z Sept 23: 90.3% of 7,532 research sessions abstained (rung 0: 95.5%), abstentions cost $112.80 of the $147.44 research spend (about $82 a day), 41% of the gate's runs were `clock` or `backoff_elapsed`, and half the hand-read abstentions said nothing had changed since the last pass. clock_runs `winners_and_idle`: a session is due only on a trigger (a fill, settlement, refusal, active block, audit or repair verdict, code or rung change, a lesson or note for its desk, a fulfilled request, a lifted blocker); a winner (positive earned record, already at winner_share of the interval) and an idle agent (at the idle cadence) still run on the clock; the max_skip_hours heartbeat and the sample stay. abstain_lock_after 3: after three abstaining sessions in a row an agent researches only on a settlement, a fill or a refusal until a session produces a candidate. `all` / 0 restore the Sept 22 rule. Every research.gate row carries `trigger` and `record`, and `python -m league.research_gate LEDGER` prices each trigger (by_trigger).

horizon._about: Fast feedback: no Kalshi entry expected to resolve later than this, and no crypto position held longer. Equities and options are not bounded.

merton._about: How often each of Merton's roles sits down, in hours, during the expedition. The pacer still gates every pass on the day's allowance, so this is how often a role MAY run, not how often it must.

frontier_reserve._about: Dollars left in the gateway's monthly frontier budget (GET /v1/health) below which frontier work narrows. Under earned_usd, cheap-model research moves to Sail and the unearned roles (operator, teacher, designer) pause; under code_roles_usd the architect and toolsmith pause too, and only audits and consultations by profitable agents remain. Promotion to real money needs an audit, so the month's last dollars are kept for it.

hypotheses._about: The hypothesis foundry (league/hypotheses.py): Merton writes 3-4 falsifiable strategy cards for the desk the evidence favours (exploration_share of calls go to the least-explored desk), replay admits them before any paper seat, and routine refill stops breeding random mutations. Calls are at most one per call_minutes, only while a seat is open, the frontier tier pays for code work and the day's OpenAI allowance has room, and never past budget_usd within budget_window_hours. It writes on `model` (GPT-6 Sol from Sept 22, 2026, at high effort and a quarter-hour cadence: about a fifth of Astra's price, so the same budget buys four to five times the cards); the auditor and the engineer keep Astra. A family with retire_after_failures counted replay failures and no pass is retired from House breeding. mutation_share (at least mutation_min_per_day) bounds House mutations, and only of parents earning forward.
hypotheses._about_sept23: Sept 23, 2026 (the owner: a 24/7 swarm; 'do 1-5 right now fully'): the first GPT-6 Sol call wrote 4 cards for $0.128 and one was on paper 43 s later, while agent research cost about $1 per replay-passing candidate. So the foundry gets more of the budget ($40 a window, a call every 10 minutes), half of its calls go to the fast-evidence desks (hourly, around the clock) whose low pass rates never win the evidence route, cards may queue for replay (max_pending_cards) instead of holding the next call, and Merton is told to prefer hourly programs where a desk allows them.
hypotheses._about_sept23c: Sept 23, 2026 (the learn-and-unblock run, S3/C3: the foundry follows yield). Measured since Sept 22 13:30Z: the foundry was the only paid source to reach real money (108 cards for $8.48, 33 replay passes, 27 born, 2 on rung 2; $0.26 a replay pass) and the practice loss engine: foundry-born agents were -$272.96 of the -$361 kalshi-shadow loss, two BTC-strike cards -$113.68 in ten settlements, kalshi-crypto-strikes -10.3% an active block (40 born, 2 replay passes ever), kalshi-crypto-15m -1.9% a block with taker entries at 182 bps. So kalshi-crypto-strikes leaves fast_desks; a desk whose foundry-born agents are negative over fast_lane_min_blocks (6) active blocks (league/hypotheses.py desk_forward, from eval.block rows) gets no fast-lane call until one family there is positive over fast_lane_reopen_blocks (3), and the open fast desks are ranked by that yield before the rotation; the exploration share is unchanged; the brief tells Merton that kalshi-crypto-15m needs maker entries and that a binary position above 15% of the stake is a one-loss trial. The foundry runs at the `earned` frontier tier (it is the best yield per dollar) and stops only at `audits`, as before.
hypotheses._about_sept23b: Sept 23, 2026 (the owner's north star: a swarm that trades 24/7 and compounds). Measured 01:39-02:10Z: 4 of 8 GPT-6 Sol cards passed replay at about $0.03 a card, the best yield in the league, but the foundry never exploited what already works. The only mechanism with real-money profit (Kalshi daily favourites bought as a maker: mullins-2 and mullins-6 on weather, hawkins-19 on commodities, all live) was never offered to a desk where it had not been tried, and 12 of the 16 merged repairs failed replay, so self-improvement was fixing bugs, not finding edges. The fast route sent every fast call to the best-scored fast desk, the index-ETF desk, so the 24/7 crypto desks got no cards. Now up to transfer_share of calls take a family with an earned forward record (real money first) to the best-scored desk of its venue where it was never tried, and Merton adapts its mechanism there; the fast route rotates to the fast desk with the fewest recent cards; every packet carries the league's edge map (winning_mechanisms). Precedence: transfer, fast, exploration, else evidence; with 0.3, 0.5 and 0.2 that is about 27%, 45%, 18% and 9% of calls (the evidence route had about 36% before transfers).

consult._about: What it costs an agent to hire Merton, the frontier model, out of its own credits, and what it must have DONE to be allowed to. Frontier intelligence is the scarcest thing on the floor: it is the prize for trading well, never a rebate for existing. An agent that has not traded is served by Merton's own roles -- the architect who writes strategies, the toolsmith who builds what the queue asks for, the teacher who writes the lessons -- which cost it nothing and reach the whole firm.

lab._about: The Alpha Lab (league/lab.py), Sept 23, 2026, the north-star build: a MAP-Elites archive of strategy programs searched in batches on the lab box (league/labbox.py). Seeds are the living agents' programs, the foundry's cards and the founders; children are parameter mutants of the archive's elites and Luna's mutations and crossovers, with a Sol leap every leap_every Luna calls. Fitness is out-of-sample growth after fees on the first search_fraction of the House's own replay tape; the fittest gate-passing program of a cell is replayed by the House on the whole tape (and by the sealed holdout on the history store) and born on paper, at most max_births_per_hour. OpenAI spend is its own line (budget_usd_per_hour, plus royalties: royalty_share of a graduate's performance fee), inside the campaign allowance and only while the frontier tier is 'all'. It runs only where league/config.json names a lab box.
lab._about_sept23_pacing: Sept 23, 2026, 16:41 UTC (C3 pacing, the learn-and-unblock run): the lab's Luna seeds and Sol leaps share the paced September OpenAI line, so the lab's own LLM line is $0.75 an hour until the month resets on Oct 1; parameter children, batch replay on the lab box and graduation spend no OpenAI and are unchanged.
